title: Distributed rate limiter
summary: Limit how many requests each client may make, consistently across a fleet of API gateways.
functional: Allow or reject each request by client key and rule
Rules per key: N requests per window, with bursts
non_functional: Adds under 5 ms p99 to each request
Fails open if the counter store is down (availability over strictness)
Accurate within a few percent across the fleet

api_requests_per_day.why: A large public API across all clients.

active_keys.why: Users, API tokens and IP addresses seen in a window.

bytes_per_key.why: Sliding-window counter: key, two counters and expiry, plus store overhead.

store_ops_per_check.why: One atomic script call (read, increment, expire) per request.

store_ops_per_node.why: Measured order of magnitude for one Redis or Valkey shard with small scripts.

replication_factor.why: Counters are cheap to lose; one replica per shard is enough.

derived.name: store_ops
derived.label: Counter-store operations per second at peak
